episodes.title: Galanthus Byzantinus
episodes.summary: After an incident at the supermarket, Murat gets on Anton`s radar and has to leave his hideout in search of a lost friend presumed to be dead.

episodes.title: Kedi, Kutu, Huni
episodes.summary: Anton listens to Murat`s taped recordings. With the AEI on his tail, Murat must find a way into the 6th Zone. Anton hides a personal secret.

episodes.title: 6. Bölge
episodes.summary: Murat recalls his past in the 6th Zone. Convinced of Murat`s immunity, Sule introduces him to Plus 1 researchers. The blue pills provide a lead.

episodes.title: Yüksek Ateş
episodes.summary: Anton searches for Murat and must confront Canan. Conflicts erupt within the Plus 1. Yasemin plays mind games with Murat. Fazil decides to punish Canan.

episodes.title: Şafak Söktü, Akrep Öldü
episodes.summary: Anton must fly under the radar, but Fazil forces his hand. Ozgur recounts the day of the fire. As Murat faces a moral dilemma, Viktor`s order arrives.

episodes.title: 7’ye 13 kala
episodes.summary: Fazil detains Emel, Anton tries to contact Murat, and Sule must decrypt a message. Disturbed by his re-encounter with Haluk, Murat devises a risky plan.

episodes.title: Gül ve Diken
episodes.summary: AEI tightens security. Murat and Sule try to prevent the attack. Murat negotiates with Fazil. D-Day arrives for everyone, but Fazil has his own agenda.

episodes.title: Adımın bir önemi yok
episodes.summary: The explosion leads to a manhunt. Murat questions his connection to Haluk. After a tragedy, Murat makes a bold decision - and he won`t leave anyone behind.
